request: Build a small Jac web app for a live capture-the-flag scoreboard. Teams submit flags for challenges worth points. A team's first correct flag for a challenge awards the points and pushes a scoreboard update to subscribers. Teams are ranked by points, ties broken by who reached that score first.
acceptance: A second correct submission of the same challenge by the same team awards nothing and pushes no update.
Two teams with 300 points are ordered by the time of their last scoring solve, earliest first.
A wrong flag never changes the scoreboard; submissions after the end time are rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Deliver events through an in-process event bus that tests can subscribe to; no sockets, no network, no background servers.
Keep the logic deterministic: time is passed in, never read from the clock inside the rules.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
